name: Shoujo to Sekai to Okashi no Ken ~Route of Ichigo 1~
original_name: 少女と世界とお菓子の剣 ～Route of ICHIGO 1～
source:
A new school year begins for Minoru and his childhood friend Ayano. But this year will be different. 9 year old Haruna Ichigo has skipped grades and transferred into their class.

Minoru joins the fortune telling club where he meets 14 year old upperclassman Tatsugawa Nanako. Mysteries surround the school as children go missing and Minoru begins hearing cries for help on his radio. Ichigo possesses the power of turning candy into a sword "The Sword of the Sweets" and Nana possesses the power of commanding people to obey her with her magic lipstick and compact. The friends set out to solve the mysteries of this world.


Contains a side story where Minoru is upset at the conclusion of the game being "To be continued" so he purchases a copy of his own game [url=/v12231]Shoujo to Sekai to Okashi no Ken ~Route of Ichigo 1~[/url] and [url=/v7432]Shiiko Love ~Usugurai Heya no Naka de Shoujo o Model ni Eroge Seisaku~[/url] so that he can have sex with both Ichigo and [url=/c4482]Someya Shiiko[/url] at once.
